name: Ryoushi-san
source:
A hunter that Tiana saved when he had problems with his traps. Ryoushi-san is taciturn, and doesn't talk about himself much. He makes his livelihood hunting in the Lost Forest, particularly hunting wolves. He calls himself "an old man" and Tiana "a young lady". He has a hidden home in the forest, and doesn't leave until his wounds heal.

He tells her of a past incident where a villager was killed by a wolf... but which wolf?

[Spoiler]According to his ending bonus "Secret Memo", Ryoushi-san's real name is Gerard, his favourite food is meatloaf, favourite colour is blue and his hobby is the maintenance of his firearms.[/spoiler]

[Taken from the [url=http://calameliatorte.com/character_hunter.php]official website[/url]]
